source: Mainnet blocks 3436131-3436171 (NU6.3, after activation at 3428143), fetched 2026-09-11 from https://api.blockchair.com/zcash/raw/block/<height>. Each header is the first 1487 bytes of raw_block; its SHA-256d was checked against decoded_raw_block.hash and each header's hashPrevBlock against the one below. txids are decoded_raw_block.tx, in display order; coinbase_version is the first transaction's header word from raw_block (80000005 = v5, 80000006 = v6). Blockchair is not a primary source; the pin is, and every header below it is fixed by the links and its own Equihash.
